ValidationRule.description: Customer ID and Source System can only be updated by system administrator
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND (NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE( Customer_Account_Number__c ))), OR(ISCHANGED(Customer_Account_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Source_System__c )), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin" , $Profile.Name <> "IME_JV_Admin", $Profile.Name <>"IM_API Only_Admin", $Profile.Name <>"IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_Custom Sys",
NOT( $Permission.Update_Customer_ID_Source_System ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer ID/Account Number and/or Source System can only be updated by the system administrator. Please raise a case to have this updated.
